headline: Renewed Violence Grips Callahan’s Passage as Central Fronts Grind On
war_summary: Since the last dispatch, fierce base contention has re-erupted in Callahan’s Passage, where The Crumbling Passage and The Latch saw five tactical transitions alongside over 5,800 casualties in two hours. High-intensity fighting endures unabated across the central and eastern sectors, with Weathered Expanse and Stlican Shelf logging steady handovers and heavy losses across Wightwalk, Frostmarch, and Breaker Town. In the western islands, Fisherman’s Row sustains steady friction following its earlier flurry of captures, while Linn of Mercy registers renewed base shifts around Lathair and Rotdust under sharp Warden casualty pressure. Conversely, frontline movement has quieted in Mooring County and Marban Hollow after earlier exchanges, though Nevish Line continues to experience surging bloodshed and enlistment despite stalled base conversions. The remaining territorial hexes and interior logistics hubs report minimal contact.
